</header><div class="entry-content" itemprop="text"><h2>CAP meetings are held on the fourth Tuesday of the month commencing at 9:30am.</h2>
<p>The meetings are held in the Council Chambers Minlaton Town Hall, 57 Main Street, Minlaton.</p>
<p><span id="more-3371"></span></p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel has been established for the purpose of acting as a delegate of the Council in its role as a “relevant authority” under the Planning Development and Infrastructure Act 2016.</p>
<p>The Council Assessment has its own <a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Assessment-Panel-Terms-of-Reference-Adopted-10-December-2025.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Reference</a> and <a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2025/08/Council-Assessment-Panel-Meeting-Procedures-Adopted-22072025.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Meeting Procedures</a>.</p>
<p>The Minister has adopted a <a href="https://dit.sa.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0008/353672/Code_of_Conduct_-_Assessment_Panel_Members.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">code of conduct</a> to be observed by members of the Council Assessment Panel. The code of conduct sets out standards of conduct and professionalism that are to be observed by all members of an assessment panel</p>
<p><strong>Some of these files are large</strong>. If you experience any difficulties with the size of the files, contact the Maitland Office for assistance on 08 8832 0000.</p>
<p> </p>

<h2>2020</h2>
<h3><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">December</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 8 December 2020</span></p>
<p><a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2020/12/Council-Assessment-Panel-Minutes-08122020.pdf">Council Assessment Panel Minutes – 8 December 2020</a></p>

<h3><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;">November</span></h3>

<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2020/11/Council-Assessment-Panel-Agenda-24112020-1.pdf">Council Assessment Panel Agenda – 24 November 2020 – Cancelled</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><i><span style="color: #303030;">Council Assessment Panel – COVID 19 Restrictions – <b>Meeting Cancelled.</b></span></i></span></p>
<p style="line-height: 10.5pt;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><i><span style="color: #303030;">In the interest of community health and safety the 24 November 2020 Council Assessment Panel meeting has been cancelled.</span></i></span></p>
<p style="line-height: 10.5pt;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><i><span style="color: #303030;">The meeting has been rescheduled for Tuesday 8 December 2020 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton. An updated Agenda will be available in due course.</span></i></span></p>
<p style="line-height: 10.5pt;"><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><i><span style="color: #303030;">Please contact Council if you have any questions on 8832 0000.</span></i></span></p>

<h3>November 2021</h3>
<p><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 23 November</p>

<h3>October 2021</h3>
<p><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 26 October</p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting scheduled for 26 October 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for 23 November 2021 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton.</p>
<h3>September 2021</h3>
<p><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 28 September</p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting scheduled for 28 September 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for 26 October 2021 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton.</p>
<h3>August 2021</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 24 August</span></p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting scheduled for 24 August 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for 28 September 2021 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton.</p>
<h3>July 2021</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 27 July</span></p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting scheduled for 27 July 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for 24 August 2021 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton.</p>
<h3>June 2021</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 22 June</span></p>
<p><a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2021/06/Council-Assessment-Panel-Agenda-22062021.pdf">Assessment Panel Agenda – 22 June</a><br />
<a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2021/06/Council-Assessment-Panel-Minutes-22062021.pdf">Assessment Panel Minutes – 22 June</a></p>
<h3>May 2021</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 25 May</span></p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting scheduled for 25 May 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for Tuesday 22 June 2021 at 9.30 am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton.</p>
<h3>April</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 27 April</span></p>
<p><a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2021/04/Webiste-Council-Assessment-Panel-Agenda-27042021-Copy.pdf">Assessment Panel Agenda –  27 April</a></p>
<p><a href="https://yorke.sa.gov.au/content/uploads/2021/04/Council-Assessment-Panel-Minutes-27042021.pdf">Assessment Panel Minutes – 27 April</a></p>
<h3>March</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 23 March</span></p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting Scheduled for 23 March 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for Tuesday 27 April 2021 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton.</p>
<h3>February</h3>
<p><span style="font-family: georgia, palatino, serif;"><strong>Meeting date:</strong> 23 February</span></p>
<p>The Council Assessment Panel meeting scheduled for Tuesday 23 February 2021 at 9.30am has been cancelled. The next meeting is scheduled for Tuesday 23 March 2021 at 9.30am at the Council Chamber, Minlaton</p>
